payload.tension: The passage states luke 8:27–31 identifies a qualified or nonhuman spirit within a scene where it is locally described; the wording centers on “Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man.” It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the Spirit.
